summary: Your Outlook / Microsoft 365 calendars and calendar links in FBRX: an agenda and a week view, meeting reminders, today on FBRX Glass, and Fabrix knows what is on.
notes: New Calendar page (Studio): sign in to Outlook / Microsoft 365 in your browser, or paste a calendar link from Outlook.com, Google, Apple or your school.
Agenda and week views, Join buttons for online meetings, event details, and new events in your Outlook calendar.
Reminders before meetings (5 to 30 minutes, or never), and what is left today on FBRX Glass.
Fabrix can tell you what is on, find a free hour, and add an event (it asks first).
Plugins can read your calendar when they ask for the new calendar permission.
Organizations can set the Microsoft sign-in for every computer from FBRX Command.
